name: Setup
updates.body: Install automatically at night. A restart may be needed.
gesture.1: Swipe left or right to change pages
gesture.2: Swipe up or down to change styles
gesture.3: Swipe down from the top to open controls
gesture.4: Swipe right from the left edge to go back
gesture.5: Swipe up from the bottom to go home
gesture.6: Press and hold to open settings
gesture.7: Hold the top left with two fingers for 5 seconds to open maintenance
